meta.what: Simplified base geometry for the inline SVG map: land, the five boroughs, state and county lines.
meta.source: US Census Bureau: Cartographic Boundary Files 2023, counties, 1:500,000; TIGER/Line 2023 AREAWATER for each county in the frame (water cut out of the land)
meta.water_rule: water polygons of at least 150000 m2, merged; bodies under about 3 km2 dropped
meta.simplification: Douglas-Peucker, tolerance 0.0008 degrees of latitude on longitude-scaled coordinates; islands under 6e-06 square degrees dropped; lines at 0.002 to 0.004
meta.label_note: Label positions are hand-placed approximate points for place names, not measured data.
